title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Ending Cover and Callouts Already Dispatched
content:
The member ends their own Keyturn Roadside Assistance cover on the plan's notice, and where the minimum
term has not run the plan's cancellation refund percentage of the unused term is returned rather than
the whole of it.

Cover ended by the member does not stop a callout already dispatched, which is completed and charged
under the terms that stood when it was called.

A subscription cancelled outright is not reinstated, and the member who wants cover again takes out a
fresh subscription and serves the waiting period afresh.

### What is returned on cancellation

Where the minimum term has not run, what is returned is the plan's cancellation refund percentage taken
of the unused term — a proportion of the unused term, and not the whole of the unused term. The notice
the member gives is the plan's notice, counted in calendar days.

### A callout in flight when cover ends

| The callout | What follows |
| --- | --- |
| Already dispatched when the member ended cover | It is completed; it is charged under the terms that stood when it was called, not under any later basis |

### Cancellation and a later wish for cover

A subscription cancelled outright is closed to reinstatement. A member who wants cover on the vehicle
again takes out a fresh subscription, and the waiting period is served afresh on that new subscription
rather than treated as already served.
